#ifndef __route_h
  #define __route_h

#ifndef __QBFC_EXTERN
    #ifdef __ILEC400__
        #define QBFC_EXTERN extern
    #else
        #define QBFC_EXTERN extern "C"
    #endif

    #define __QBFC_EXTERN
#endif

/*********************************************************************/
/* Header files                                                      */
/*********************************************************************/

#include <net/if.h>                   /* interface macros/structures */
#include <sys/socket.h>               /* sockaddr structure          */
#include <sys/types.h>                /* common typedefs             */
#ifndef _H_IN                                                  /*@A1A*/
#include <netinet/in.h>                                        /*@A1A*/
#endif                                                         /*@A1A*/
#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=510)  /* @B1A*/
#pragma datamodel(P128)      /* @B1A*/
#endif                       /* @B1A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for rt_flags field in rtentry structure                    */
/*********************************************************************/

#define RTF_BLACKHOLE            0x0040  /* route is black hole -
                                            silently drop            */
#define RTF_DYNAMIC              0x0010  /* created dynamically      */
#define RTF_GATEWAY              0x0002  /* destination is a gateway */
#define RTF_GATEWAY_PROBLEMATIC  0x0080  /* route gateway may have
                                            problems                 */
#define RTF_HOST                 0x0004  /* host entry (otherwise
                                            network entry)           */
#define RTF_MODIFIED             0x0020  /* modified dynamically     */
#define RTF_NOREBIND_IFC_ACTV    0x0200  /* do not rebind route to
                                            another interface on
                                            activation/deactivation
                                            of interfaces            */
#define RTF_NOREBIND_IFC_FAIL    0x0100  /* do not rebind route to
                                            another interface if
                                            interface fails          */
#define RTF_TOS_IS_PRIORITY      0x0400  /* indicates rt_TOS field in
                                            the rtentry structure will
                                            contain the route priority
                                            rather than the type of
                                            service             @A1A */
#define RTF_UP                   0x0001  /* route is usable          */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for rt_protocol field in rtentry structure                 */
/*********************************************************************/

#define RTP_OTHER                1    /* route learned, sockets, etc */
#define RTP_CONFIG               2    /* route learned, configuration*/
#define RTP_SNMP                 3    /* route learned, SNMP         */
#define RTP_ICMP                 4    /* route learned, ICMP         */
#define RTP_EGP                  5    /* route learned, EGP          */
#define RTP_GGP                  6    /* route learned, GGP          */
#define RTP_HELLO                7    /* route learned, HELLO        */
#define RTP_RIP                  8    /* route learned, RIP          */
#define RTP_ISIS                 9    /* route learned, IS-IS        */
#define RTP_ESIS                10    /* route learned, ES-IS        */
#define RTP_CIGRP               11    /* route learned, Cisco IGRP   */
#define RTP_BSIGRP              12    /* route learned, BBN SPF IGRP */
#define RTP_OSPF                13    /* route learned, OSPF         */
#define RTP_BGP                 14    /* route learned, BGP          */


/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for rt_protocol field in ip6rtentry structure              */
/*********************************************************************/

#define IP6_RTP_OTHER      1    /* route learned, sockets, etc  @A2A */
#define IP6_RTP_LOCAL      2    /* route learned, configuration @A2A */
#define IP6_RTP_NETMGMT    3    /* route learned, netwrk mgmt   @A2A */
#define IP6_RTP_NDISC      4    /* route learned, neighbor disc @A2A */
#define IP6_RTP_RIP        5    /* route learned, RIPng         @A2A */
#define IP6_RTP_OSPF       6    /* route learned, OSPF          @A2A */
#define IP6_RTP_BGP        7    /* route learned, BGP           @A2A */
#define IP6_RTP_IDRP       8    /* route learned, InterDomain   @A2A */
#define IP6_RTP_IGRP       9    /* route learned, InterGateway  @A2A */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros for rt_priority field in ip6rtentry structure         @A1A */
/*********************************************************************/

#define RTP_LOW_PRIORITY        -1    /* low priority           @A1A */
#define RTP_MEDIUM_PRIORITY      0    /* medium priority        @A1A */
#define RTP_HIGH_PRIORITY        1    /* high priority          @A1A */

/*********************************************************************/
/* Macros to simplify access to rtc_rtcu union in rtconf structure   */
/*********************************************************************/

#define rtc_buf    rtc_rtcu.rtcu_buf
#define rtc_req    rtc_rtcu.rtcu_req

/*********************************************************************/
/* Structures                                                        */
/*********************************************************************/

struct rtentry {                      /* route entry                 */

  struct sockaddr rt_dst;             /* route destination
                                         net/subnet/host             */
  struct sockaddr rt_mask;            /* route mask                  */
  struct sockaddr rt_gateway;         /* gateway's IP address        */
  int     rt_mtu;                     /* MTU for route               */
  u_short rt_flags;                   /* route flags                 */
  u_short rt_refcnt;                  /* number held references      */
  u_char  rt_protocol;                /* route protocol, how route
                                         was learned                 */
  u_char  rt_TOS;                     /* route type-of-service       */
  char    rt_if[IFNAMSIZ];            /* interface used for route    */

};

struct ip6rtentry {                   /* IPv6 route entry       @A1A */
  struct  sockaddr_in6 rt_dst;        /* route destination
                                         net/subnet/host        @A1A */
  struct  sockaddr_in6 rt_nexthop;    /* next hop IP address    @A1A */
  int     rt_mtu;                     /* MTU for route          @A1A */
  u_short rt_flags;                   /* route flags            @A1A */
  u_char  rt_prefixlen;               /* length of the prefix   @A1A */
  u_char  rt_protocol;                /* route protocol, how route
                                         was learned            @A1A */
  char    rt_priority;                /* route priority         @A1A */
  char    rt_if[32];                  /* interface used for route@A1A*/
};                                                           /* @A1A */

struct rtconf {                       /* route configuration list    */

  int rtc_len;                        /* size of user-supplied buffer*/
  int rtc_configured;                 /* number of interfaces
                                         configured                  */
  int rtc_returned;                   /* number of interfaces
                                         returned                    */
  union {
     caddr_t      rtcu_buf;           /* user-supplied buffer address*/
     struct rtentry *rtcu_req;        /* returned list of interfaces */
  } rtc_rtcu;

};

#if (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=510)  /* @B1A*/
#pragma datamodel(pop)       /* @B1A*/
#endif                       /* @B1A*/

#endif /* __route_h */

#ifdef __cplusplus
    #pragma info(restore)
#else
    #pragma checkout(resume)
#endif
